Name: Core Passive: Dirge of Destiny
Additional Ability: Prophetic Tears
Descriptions:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Featherbloom</color> hits a target that is suffering from an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, or <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color> Anomaly, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, dealing additional Attribute Anomaly DMG. The additional DMG is <color=#FE437E>3.07%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>1.6%</color>/<color=#FF5521>4%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>0.37%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>0.54%</color> per 10 points of Anomaly Proficiency of the original Anomaly DMG.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Featherbloom</color> hits a target suffering any Attribute Anomaly, it will inflict <color=#FFFFFF>Vivian's Prophecy</color>, causing the target to take <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> equal to 55% of Vivian's ATK every 0.55s. This DMG can trigger additional DMG from Attribute Anomalies. <color=#FFFFFF>Vivian's Prophecy</color> ends when the target is no longer suffering an Attribute Anomaly.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian gains 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color>.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same attribute:
Whenever another squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Vivian will consume 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feather</color> to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Featherbloom</color> on the target. This can trigger once every 0.5s.
<color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> DMG dealt by all squad members and the <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> status' <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>.

Cons.Name: "Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"
Cons.Effect: When a total of 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> are consumed, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG received by targets under <color=#FFFFFF>Vivian's Prophecy</color> increases by 16%.

Cons.Name: "Stormy Night, Stormy Night"
Cons.Effect: Vivian's <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by 25%. The benefits of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> from Anomaly Proficiency are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.

Cons.Name: "The Wind Between the Reeds"
Cons.Effect: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Featherbloom</color> will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color>.

Cons.Name: "Vivian"
Cons.Effect: Vivian's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Dodge during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz</color>'s dash, or using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem</color>, gain 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>. Launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension</color> consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color>, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>. Each additional <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feather</color> consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, consuming a maximum of 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.
